answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 55 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The shale register is checked at draw time, umber lists the eligible set, and vault seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 55 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 141 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
